title: NES controller-port bridge, v1b
intro: The bench that drives an unmodified NES-001 through its controller port and records what the console does about it. This package is the v1b build: an Arduino UNO between a Raspberry Pi and the console, everything on one 5 V rail.

The schematic sheets are drawn by tools/draw-schematics.py. The parts list and the wiring list on the later sheets are not typed: they are read back out of that same file, so a part or a connection cannot be on a sheet and missing from a list, or renamed on a sheet without the list following.
Widths and levels marked AUTHORED have not been measured. Everything marked MEASURED carries the date it was taken and is in docs/lab-notebook.md with the record it came from.
